units.text: The assertion is true: two ESCAPADE spacecraft (Blue and Gold) were launched aboard Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket from Florida on November 13, 2025, for NASA. Span 76 and 81 confirm the launch date and vehicle; Span 135 confirms the date and Florida site; Span 6 and 7 from the Blue Origin press and

judgement.reason: The passages state that two ESCAPADE spacecraft (Blue and Gold) were launched on November 13, 2025, aboard a Blue Origin New Glenn rocket from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, and describe the mission as NASA's.

units.text: The launch occurred on November 13, 2025, at approximately 3:55 PM EST / 20:55 UTC from Launch Complex 36 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. Blue Origin's press release confirms the dual deployment and liftoff time; NASA SVS page confirms the date, rocket, and twin spacecraft
